text:
A battlefield controller who heals allies and dominates enemies.

Primary: WIS | Secondary: INT

MP mechanic: MP regenerates natively for spell costs. Chain Heal has been removed and replaced by the shrine and pulse spells below.

Spells:
Quick Mend - fast low-cooldown heal
Stasis - freeze + invulnerable AoE
Stacia's Shrine - evolving shrine, heals then adds attack buff, then shield, then speed at higher levels
Stacia's Judgment - damage shrine
Stacia's Pulse - boomerang, damages enemies and heals allies on both directions
Void Storm - frontal cone darkness damage
Jaunt - 3-tile blink gap closer
